pass_condition: The named approver authorized the test and the package matches the expected vendor and version
evidence_to_save: Approval reference, vendor download location, installer version, signature result and signer
pause_if: Approval is missing or the installer signature or source differs

pass_condition: One matching device appears in the approved customer and site with a recent check-in
evidence_to_save: Asset reference, customer, site, policy, agent version and first check-in time
pause_if: The record is duplicated, stale or assigned to the wrong customer or site

pass_condition: The assigned test technician can perform the approved action and the console denies the out-of-scope action
evidence_to_save: Allowed action result, denied action result, technician reference and audit event
pause_if: The restricted action succeeds or an action cannot be attributed

pass_condition: One authorized test job reaches the intended device and the technician can verify the result locally
evidence_to_save: Job ID, target, completion timestamp, output and before-and-after result
pause_if: The job reaches another device or the console and local outcomes disagree

pass_condition: One test alert reaches the intended queue and telemetry resumes after the approved interruption
evidence_to_save: Alert ID, owning queue, last check-in before interruption and first check-in after recovery
pause_if: The alert is misrouted or the restored device does not check in

pass_condition: The supported uninstall completes and the old record no longer permits a privileged action
evidence_to_save: Uninstall result, device-side component check and console access check
pause_if: A privileged component or authorized management session remains unexpectedly active
